reason: I already reorder my Toplux when it runs out and I barely remember to take what I have as it is. The lab report is a nice touch, but it does not make me switch something that is already in my routine.
objection: I am already set with my usual brand, and I forget vitamins half the time, so another one just sits on the counter.
would_change_my_mind: If a sachet came with a clear reason it works better than what I take now, like a real result I could see, and the first box was cheap enough that skipping it costs me nothing.
